title: instructions-loaded-audit telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the instructions-loaded-audit InstructionsLoaded emitter. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "instructions-loaded-audit". Evolves additive-only.

subject.description: "<file_path>:<load_reason>" for the loaded rule/instruction file, so consumers can group loads by reason (e.g. "path_glob_match", "include") without parsing extra fields. session_start loads are filtered out at the producer by default.
